text:
Zoe: Dropped a quick sketch for the invoice-reconciliation view: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz-recon. Key questions: placement of Download CTA, tiny trend sparkline, and how to surface token vs cost breakdowns for accountants. PTAL.
Ravi: First impression: the per-row CTA on the far right is easy to scan but pushes the amount off-screen on narrow layouts. Maybe move CTA into row overflow and add a persistent floating bulk button?
Ivy: Floating bulk button could overlap content on mobile. What about a sticky footer bulk action that appears when rows are selected? That feels discoverable and avoids header clutter.
Ken: Sticky footer is good. For keyboard users make sure it appears in the tab order and is reachable with screen reader announcement.
Marco: Sparkline: love it, but it's tiny. Suggest a hover-to-expand micro-interaction that reveals a mini-panel with the last 30 days. For dense mode hide the inline sparkline.
Zoe: Noted. I'll add hover expand and a dense toggle. Also considering default scope: org vs project. Should the landing scope respect last-used or role?
Ravi: Respect last-used first, then fall back to role. Add a small tooltip the first time: "Scope remembered per user".
Ivy: Token vs $ breakdown: don't combine them in one stacked bar. If showing both, use a small inline toggle to switch metrics or show a dual-axis with clear color pills. Users got confused during research.
Ken: Microcopy: change "tokens" -> "API tokens consumed" where space allows. In tight UI use "tokens" but tooltip expands to the full label.
Marco: Accessibility: color contrast fail on the teal legend chip at 14px. Also the small hover-only tooltip content is not keyboard accessible.
A11yBot: accessibility-scan: contrastIssue=.legend-teal; missingKeyboardTrigger=.sparkline-expand; bulkButton needs aria-hidden=false when visible; ensure aria-live on sticky-footer success messages.
Zoe: Good catches. Plan: 1) bump legend color to meet 4.5:1 at small sizes, 2) make sparkline expansion accessible via keyboard (enter/space), 3) add aria-live for "Downloaded X invoices".
Ravi: For the Download CTA label, prefer "Download PDF invoice" to avoid CSV confusion. Add "Export CSV ledger" as a secondary header action.
Ivy: Agree. And per-row overflow menu should include both options. For quick one-offs keep the per-row primary action as "Download PDF" but hide it in compact mode.
Ken: Tab order: checkbox -> invoice link -> amount -> actions menu. Make sure screenreader reads invoice id then amount, not the other way around.
Marco: Chart labels: collapse big numbers to 1 decimal + unit (e.g., 2.4M) at <560px. Show exact on hover/keyboard focus.
Zoe: I'll update the figma: add sticky-footer bulk action variant, make sparkline keyboard focusable, adjust legend colors, and rename microcopy. Will add telemetry events: billing.bulk_download.triggered (placement), billing.scope.remembered, billing.denom.toggled.
Ravi: One more: when switching scope keep filters and selections. Accountants lose context otherwise.
Ivy: Also document the A11y acceptance criteria in the spec: contrast ratios, aria labels examples, keyboard flows.
Zoe: Will push updated frames by EOD and include the a11y checklist. If no major objections we'll include sticky-footer in the A/B run next cycle. :thumbsup:
Ken: Sounds good to me.
Marco: :thumbsup: Love the sticky-footer idea.
A11yBot: re-scan pending color token update.
